The system ought to feature an interactive display for instantaneous observation and graphical representation of operational data.
The infrastructure requires a dependable data transmission framework to guarantee consistent information exchange among all smart grid elements.

Each transaction should be analyzed to assign a risk score based on various indicators like transaction size, geographical location, and user activity to aid prioritization.
Individuals or entities repeatedly linked to fraudulent acts should be blacklisted to prevent further participation in transactions.
The system must create regular reports outlining detected fraud patterns, suspicious behaviors, and case outcomes.
Integration with a machine learning model is required so the system can enhance its fraud detection capabilities using historical data and trends.

This Robotics Software is designed to manage and program robots for various operations, enabling robot initialization and configuration of components such as sensors, actuators, and control units.
The software must facilitate the robot's movement control, including advancing forward, moving backward, and rotating.
The system should offer path planning capabilities that allow the robot to navigate from a starting point to a destination while avoiding any obstacles.

The system should allow the robot to carry out sequences of tasks driven by predefined instructions.

An energy management system should be incorporated to track the robot's battery levels and regulate power consumption.
The robot must be capable of making autonomous decisions by analyzing sensor inputs and using internal algorithms.
The software must be able to identify errors within the robot system, provide feedback, and implement recovery processes.

A Manufacturing Execution System (MES) helps track and monitor the production process in real-time within manufacturing plants, providing functionality for creating, tracking, and managing production orders.

The system should collect data from machines on their operational status and performance.
The system should allow for scheduling and managing workforce shifts.
The system should track product quality checks and results.
The system should allow the configuration of production lines to meet specific product requirements.
The system should manage preventive maintenance for machines and equipment.
The system should provide real-time tracking of production progress for each order.
The system should calculate material requirements based on production orders and stock levels.
The system should generate reports and analytics on production, inventory, and workforce performance.

A Fraud Prevention System (FPS) involves various components that handle detection, prevention, and reporting of fraudulent activities. The system should authenticate users before they can access sensitive data, ensuring that only authorized individuals can view or manage fraud-related information.
The system should monitor transactions in real-time and flag any suspicious activity based on predefined thresholds.
When suspicious activities are detected, the system should send an alert to the administrators and relevant personnel.
The system should flag transactions identified as fraudulent for further investigation and take action based on severity.
Every action taken by users, including logins and transactions, should be logged for auditing purposes.
Fraudulent activities should be tracked as cases, where investigators can review and take action on each case individually.
Transactions should be assigned a risk score based on various factors, such as amount, location, and user behavior, to prioritize investigation.
Users or entities found to be repeatedly involved in fraudulent activity should be added to a blacklist, restricting further transactions.
The system should generate periodic reports detailing detected fraud patterns, suspicious activities, and case resolutions.
The system should integrate with a machine learning model to continuously improve fraud detection based on historical data and patterns.

Each PR campaign should go through an approval workflow, involving different users (e.g., PR Manager, Legal, Senior Executives).
PR campaigns may involve events such as press conferences, and the software should allow managing these events, including scheduling and guest lists.
The software must integrate with social media platforms for automated posting and monitoring media mentions related to a campaign.
The system should allow users to track the budget allocated to each PR campaign, including expenses for media buys, events, and content production.
The educational software  should allow users (students and teachers) to register and log in with unique credentials.
The software should differentiate user roles (e.g., Student and Teacher) and provide role-specific access.
Teachers should be able to create courses, including specifying course content and structure.
Students should be able to enroll in available courses.
Courses should include learning materials such as PDFs, videos, and quizzes.
Teachers should be able to create quizzes, and students should receive automated grades.
Students and teachers should engage in discussions within course-specific forums.
PlantUML:
class Forum {
  + forumId: String
  + courseId: String
  + posts: List<String>
}

Course "1" -- "1" Forum : hosts
User "1" -- "*" Forum : participates

  + courseId: String

Student "1" -- "*" Progress : tracks

Admin "1" -- "0..*" Course : manages

The system tracks and saves each user's progress in the games they play.

  purchaseDate : Date

Users can add other players to their friends list for easier interaction.
The system recommends games based on users' play history and preferences.
The Navigation Software system provides users with accurate maps, directions, location-based services, and real-time location tracking.
The system must display an interactive map for navigation.
The system must calculate the shortest route between two points.
The system must provide turn-by-turn navigation instructions.
The system must support multiple transportation modes (e.g., walking, driving).
The system must allow users to search for points of interest (POI).
The system must store and retrieve saved locations (favorites).
The system must notify users about traffic or road closures.
The system must support voice navigation and command input.
The system must provide estimated time of arrival (ETA) updates.

children.value: calculateETA(start: String, end: String, mode: String)

HumanLang: The Weather Forecasting Software provides users with accurate, real-time weather data, predictions, and alerts by collecting and analyzing meteorological data from APIs, sensors, and satellites.
The system should analyze data for anomalies like extreme temperatures or unusual patterns.
The system should use predictive algorithms to generate forecasts for the upcoming days.
The system should send alerts to users based on weather forecasts.
Users can set their preferences for receiving weather updates and alerts.
Users can view live weather updates through the software's interface.
The system should maintain an archive of past weather data for analysis.
Users can search for forecasts specific to their location.
The system should support weather updates and alerts in multiple languages.
Allow external systems to access weather data and forecasts via APIs.

The Flight Simulation Software provides an interactive environment for training pilots, simulating flight scenarios, and evaluating flight operations, and it must allow pilots to select an aircraft type for simulation.
Each aircraft must have specific flight parameters like speed, altitude, and fuel capacity.
The system must simulate weather conditions affecting flight.
PlantUML:
class Weather {
  +temperature: Double
  +windSpeed: Double
  +visibility: Double
  +getWeatherReport(): String
}
Aircraft --> Weather : "affected by"

HumanLang: The software must provide a cockpit dashboard to monitor the flight simulation in real-time.
Pilots can configure flight scenarios, including departure and destination airports.
PlantUML:
class FlightScenario {
  +departure: String
  +destination: String
  +setScenario(departure: String, destination: String): void
}

Pilot --> FlightScenario : configures
Aircraft --> FlightScenario : "assigned to"

HumanLang: The system must log flight simulation data for future analysis.
The software must simulate emergency situations like engine failure.
The software must integrate with navigation systems for real-time positioning.
The system must support multi-user functionality for team simulations.
The system must evaluate and score pilot performance after the simulation.

The accessibility software assists individuals with disabilities in interacting with computers, offering features like screen readers, voice commands, and adaptive input devices, and allows users to log in using alternative authentication methods like voice recognition or facial recognition.
The software provides text-to-speech functionality to convert screen content into speech for users with visual impairments.
The software converts spoken words into text for users with physical disabilities or difficulties in typing.
The software offers customizable themes for users with visual impairments, such as high contrast or larger text options.
The software enables users to navigate through the system using the keyboard instead of a mouse, supporting users with motor disabilities.
The software provides screen magnification for users with low vision.
The software supports input from devices like eye trackers, sip-and-puff, and adaptive switches for users with limited motor control.
The software allows users to interact with the computer through voice commands, offering full hands-free operation.
The software provides audio or visual feedback to notify users of errors or system prompts, ensuring accessibility for people with cognitive impairments.
The software allows users to set and save personal accessibility preferences, such as speech rate or text size, for a personalized experience.
Parental Control Software monitors, restricts, and manages children's computer usage, allowing parents to create an account, log in, and assign roles with different access levels.
The system should allow parents to set daily usage time limits for children’s devices.
The software should allow parents to block specific applications or games on the child’s computer.
The system should monitor and log websites visited by children, allowing parents to view the browsing history.
The software should filter inappropriate content by blocking access to websites or applications based on predefined categories (e.g., adult content).
The system should notify parents in real-time if the child attempts to access restricted content or exceeds usage limits.
The system should generate weekly or monthly reports for parents on their child's digital usage patterns.
Parents should be able to control and adjust settings remotely via an app or web interface.
In case of an emergency, the parent should be able to immediately disable all restrictions.
Parents should be able to create and update child profiles, specifying age, device preferences, and other relevant details.
Virtual Reality software creates immersive experiences, allowing users to interact with digital environments in real-time, and requires registration and login for personalized VR access.
The system must support the creation of virtual environments where users can interact, such as landscapes or rooms.
Users must be able to interact with objects within the virtual environment (e.g., picking up, moving, or using objects).
The system must render the virtual environment and objects in real-time with high visual fidelity.
The system should allow multiple users to enter and interact in the same virtual environment simultaneously.
The system must allow users to communicate using voice chat while in the virtual environment.
Objects within the virtual environment should have animations triggered by user interactions or environmental changes.
The system should support head tracking to change the user's viewpoint based on head movements in the virtual environment.
The system must support external VR controllers for hand and gesture tracking to interact with objects.
The system should allow users to transition between different virtual environments seamlessly, with loading screens if necessary.
The Robotics Software controls and programs robots to perform tasks, allowing the initialization of robots and defining components like sensors, actuators, and controllers.
The software should enable the robot to control its movement, including forward, backward, and rotation.
The software should provide path planning to navigate the robot from one point to another, avoiding obstacles.
The system should allow the robot to detect obstacles using sensors and make decisions to avoid them.
The software must enable the robot to execute a series of tasks based on predefined commands.
The software should process data from sensors to make decisions on movement and environment interaction.
The system should include a communication interface for interaction with external systems (e.g., remote control or monitoring).
The robot should have an energy management system to monitor battery status and control power usage.
The system should enable the robot to make autonomous decisions based on sensor inputs and internal algorithms.
The software must detect and handle errors in the robot’s system, providing feedback and recovery mechanisms.

The system should track likes on each giveaway post.

The system should store the results of the giveaway (winner details).
